candidateAudit.text: ALICE’S PICK #2 — AND THIS ONE IS DEFINITELY IN MY TOP 5 RESTAURANTS IN VIENNA 🤎 If you love Spanish cuisine, amazing steaks and truly great service, you need to know about this place! Welcome to INIGO ASADOR — a beautiful Spanish and Basque-inspired steakhouse in the heart of Vienna, where incredible ingredients, open-fire cooking and a lovely atmosphere come together. I genuinely loved everything about my experience here: ✨ Excellent food and high-quality ingredients 🥩 Incredible steaks cooked over an open fire 🤍 Wonderful, attentive service 🍷 A beautiful atmosphere for a special dinner And one thing you absolutely have to try: the Wagyu! It was one of my highlights of the evening and something I would come back for. Honestly, this restaurant has earned its place in my personal Top 5 restaurants in Vienna. A definite recommendation from me! 📍 INIGO ASADOR Johannesgasse 23, 1010 Vienna Save this recommendation for your next dinner in Vienna and tell me if you’ve been there already! Follow miracles_alice for more of my personal picks, beautiful places and little discoveries around Vienna. ✨ #AlicesPick #InigoAsador #ViennaRestaurants #BestRestaurantsVienna ViennaFoodGuide ViennaFoodies SteakhouseVienna ViennaTips VisitVienna
